blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Yuchengco-led PetroGreen Energy Corp. (PGEC) has secured a loan of up to P1.24 billion to help finance the construction of its Isabela solar farm. The company, through its subsidiaries Rizal Green Energy Corp. and BKS Green Energy Corp., said it signed the omnibus loan and security agreement with Rizal Commercial Banking Corp. (RCBC). […]...
